name: @ohrtech/device-sdk-web
description: The OhrTech Device SDK for web apps: what a site running as an OhrTech web app can ask the device for. The device, its updates, Wi-Fi, network, kiosk mode, power, settings, managed configuration, attestation, client certificates, USB devices, diagnostics and TEE keys. In any other browser it reports that it isn't on a device.
